sections.heading: Vantage and timing
sections.text: W-A observed from the pit-side access point between about 13:10 and 13:20. The carrier was visible against a fixed post mark. The yoke and cylinder were obscured.

sections.heading: Account
sections.text: The carrier looked stationary against the post mark while I watched. I could not see the yoke. I did not see the final release.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: This account cannot establish yoke position, hydraulic sealing or the exact time that carrier motion began. Approximate recollection is not a synchronized displacement measurement.
